bugs.rte_16: rte_16 requires valid_read of self->y in the post-call heap (Malloc_0) after the first scalar_equalsf call. Since scalar_equalsf has no published assigns contract, WP cannot equate the post-call heap with the pre-call heap and cannot carry the precondition's valid_read(self) guarantee forward. Optimistic callee hypotheses are disabled in this run, and the proof-demand protocol is also disabled, so this VO cannot be resolved until scalar_equalsf publishes assigns \nothing;.
bugs.rte_17: rte_17 requires valid_read of vT->y in the post-call heap (Malloc_0) after the first scalar_equalsf call. Same root cause as rte_16: without scalar_equalsf publishing assigns \nothing;, WP cannot transfer the precondition's valid_read(vT) guarantee into the post-call heap. Optimistic callee hypotheses and the proof-demand protocol are both disabled in this run, so this VO cannot be resolved until scalar_equalsf publishes.
